movie.title: Couples Weekend
movie.overview: What happens when a tree falls in the woods and someone does hear it? Two couples are forced to deal with such a question — and their lives in general — when a New Year's Eve trip to the woods unearths simmering feelings and the secrets they carry threaten to break their seemingly perfect relationships.

alternativeTitles.title: A Tree Fell in the Woods

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A New Year's Eve getaway in the woods turns chaotic for two couples when long-buried secrets and unspoken tensions threaten to shatter their seemingly perfect relationships.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Two couples escape to a secluded cabin for what was supposed to be a relaxing New Year's Eve retreat. However, as simmering feelings and hidden secrets begin to surface, their tight-knit dynamic quickly unravels. Forced to confront painful truths about their lives and partnerships, they must determine whether their bonds can survive the honesty. Ultimately, the quiet trip exposes the fragile reality hiding beneath their seemingly flawless facades.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: When two closely connected couples plan a New Year's Eve trip to a quiet cabin in the woods, they anticipate a peaceful weekend of celebration and rekindled romance. However, the isolated setting rapidly transforms into a pressure cooker as long-suppressed grievances and unfulfilled expectations spill over. Beneath the exterior of their picturesque relationships lie deep secrets that emerge during late-night conversations and heated confrontations. As the weekend unfolds, a pivotal event in the woods serves as a turning point, mirroring the breakdown of their carefully maintained lives. Each individual is forced to evaluate their personal choices, marital happiness, and the authenticity of their romantic connections. Tensions reach a boiling point as hidden motives and emotional betrayals are brought into the light, testing both their marriages and their friendships. In wrestling with these revelations, the four friends realize that ignoring their issues is no longer a viable option. By the time the getaway concludes, their dynamics have been fundamentally altered, forcing them to reshape their futures.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the tranquil backdrop of a winter forest, 'Couples Weekend' follows two couples who travel to a remote getaway to ring in the New Year together. What begins as an idyllic retreat soon gives way to escalating friction as unspoken resentment, hidden pasts, and personal doubts begin to breach the surface. When an unexpected turn of events in the woods forces a moment of reckoning, both couples are driven to drop their pretenses and face the raw truths about their lives and intimacy. Combining sharp humor with deep drama, the narrative explores the complexity of modern relationships, the fear of vulnerability, and the transformative cost of honesty.

story_structure.climax: The unspoken conflicts and secrets reach a critical breaking point, forcing all four individuals into a direct confrontation with the reality of their bonds.
story_structure.conflict: An unexpected event in the woods interrupts their getaway, bringing latent grievances and long-buried secrets to the surface.
story_structure.resolution: In the wake of the emotional fallout, the couples must reckon with the damage done and decide whether their relationships can endure or must end.
story_structure.introduction: Two couples travel to a secluded woods retreat for a New Year's Eve trip, projecting an image of harmony and stable relationships.
story_structure.risingAction: As isolation sets in, personal tensions escalate and hidden truths begin to unravel the foundation of both relationships.
